units.source_text: “虽然你到我家来，但你仍感到孤独吧。

en.t: Even though you come to my house, you still feel lonely, don't you?

units.source_text: 因为，我没有力量让你从根本上摆脱这种孤独。

en.t: Because I do not have the strength to free you from that loneliness at its root.

units.source_text: 很快，你就会朝别的方向去拓展你的空间；

en.t: Before long, you will turn in another direction and expand your world;

units.source_text: 很快，你就不会到我这里来了。”

en.t: Before long, you will stop coming here to me."

units.source_text: 先生这样说着，凄然地笑了。
